result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall, with no overlapping, misaligned, or broken elements. The clipped chips, carousel card, and bottom-cropped pizza card were excluded as intentional scroll affordances. Only minor content and contrast observations remain.

issues.description: The '-100%' badge on the pizza card has no context (such as a discount label or the item it applies to), so its meaning is unclear.
issues.suggestion: Add a label such as 'Free item' or 'Up to 100% off', or show the discounted item or price explicitly.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card repeats '€0 delivery' both as the top-left badge and in the metadata line below the title.
issues.suggestion: Show the delivery fee in one place only to reduce redundancy.

issues.description: The grey placeholder text in the search field ('Restaurants, dishes, groceries') has fairly low contrast against the light grey input background.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder color to meet a 4.5:1 contrast ratio against the field background.
